user.title: Add an MDA rug
user.description: Enter the Bluetooth MAC from the MDA app. You can save it before an adapter is available; setup will retry when Bluetooth can reach the rug. This version supports controller product 0x00AD. Color and dimming still need visual testing.

confirm.title: MDA-compatible rug found
confirm.description: Set up the controller at {address}? Confirm that this is your MDA rug. Shared controller hardware may also appear in other lights. Color and dimming still need visual testing.

error.invalid_address: Enter a 12-digit Bluetooth MAC address, with or without colons.
error.unsupported_device: This device does not advertise the supported MDA 0x00AD controller profile.

abort.unsupported_device: This is not the supported MDA controller profile.

init.title: Scene speed
init.description: Speed from 1 (slow) to 100 (fast). Applied the next time you select a scene.
